meta.title: The Goal Kings: Top 100 Goalscorers in Football History
meta.dataAsOf: Ronaldo & Messi: 10 Nov 2026. Ranks 1-27: IFFHS-based table, 17 Oct 2026. Ranks 28-82: RSSSF all-levels tallies, 19 Jul 2026. Ranks 83-100: rounded estimates.
meta.disclaimer: FIFA does not publish an official all-time goalscorers list, so no figure on this site is 'FIFA-official'. Totals differ between IFFHS, RSSSF, FIFA articles, Guinness and national federations depending on whether friendlies, reserve, wartime and lower-division goals are counted. Each player shows its counting basis and other published tallies.

sources.label: Wikipedia: List of footballers with 500 or more goals (IFFHS & RSSSF tables)
FIFA: The master of marksmen (Josef Bican)

tracker.projectionNote: Illustrative projection from career scoring rate and an assumed fixture pace. Edit both values below as the schedule becomes clear.

players.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
players.notes: 985 total = 839 club + 146 Portugal, as reported by several trackers on 10 Nov 2026. The IFFHS-based table (17 Oct) showed 981, so the league figure was raised by 4 to reconcile. Trackers differ slightly (983-985), so check before each update.
players.source: Wikipedia 'List of footballers with 500 or more goals' (IFFHS-based table, 17 Oct 2026)

players.name: Lionel Messi
players.notes: 937 total as of Nov 2026 (table showed 936 on 17 Oct; league raised by 1). World Cup tally after the 2026 tournament is reported as 18-21 by different outlets; 19 is used here.
players.source: Wikipedia 'List of footballers with 500 or more goals' (IFFHS-based table, 17 Oct 2026)

players.name: Josef Bican
